items.question: Which additional embodied yoginī forms participate in devotional knowledge on earth?
premises: The preceding enumeration identifies specific embodied forms as knowers through devotion on earth.
The owl-woman, peacock-woman, sararī-woman, and gūlī-woman are named in continuation of that enumeration.
Disjunctive and comparative particles present these forms as further included instances.
items.inference: These additional embodied yoginī forms are likewise included among those who know through devotion on earth.
uncertainties: The precise identity or symbolic significance of sararī and gūlī remains unclear from the token list alone.
items.plain_english: The owl-woman, the peacock-woman, the sararī-woman, and likewise the gūlī-woman also know through devotion on earth.
